channel.title: Tack, tack!
channel.description: Designer lighting and objects from Tack, tack! in Hong Kong.

item.title: Flowerpot VP9 · Swim Blue · Good
item.description: Verner Panton designed the Flowerpot in 1968. The VP9 is the portable one: a lacquered polycarbonate shade and base, Ø16 × H 29.5 cm, with a built-in LED and a touch dimmer. It charges by USB. Charger included. New retail is about HK$1,740. Good: three small marks, two on the shade top and one on the base.

item.title: Journey Wall Lamp SHY2
item.description: Signe Hytte designed the Journey SHY2 in 2018 for &Tradition: a mouth-blown opal-glass sphere on a lacquered steel wall base, H 24 × W 18 × L 26 cm. This one is black. Condition is Good. There is a small hairline crack on the opal glass near the base join. New retail is about HK$2,680. It is a 220–240V fitting, which suits Hong Kong. Takes a G9 bulb. Installation is available as an add-on, quoted on WhatsApp.

item.title: Flowerpot VP9 · Mustard
item.description: Verner Panton designed the Flowerpot in 1968. The VP9 is the portable one: a lacquered polycarbonate shade and base, Ø16 × H 29.5 cm, with a built-in LED and a touch dimmer. It charges by USB. This Mustard lamp is Excellent. New retail is about HK$1,740.

item.title: Mist Pendant AP15
item.description: Mist AP15 is a small pendant by All the Way to Paris for &Tradition. The shade is mouth-blown opal glass, about Ø25 × H 13 cm, with white aluminium details and a textile cord. This one is brand new. The cord and a bulb are included. New retail is about HK$3,190. It is a 220–240V fitting, which suits Hong Kong. Installation is available as an add-on, quoted on WhatsApp.

item.title: Double Face Clock, Rectangle · Grey
item.description: The kind of two-sided clock you'd check on a station platform, reworked for home. DULTON drew it as a long, low rectangle so it sits comfortably under HK ceiling heights, with embossed resin details and a glass cover. In grey it leans industrial, closest to the station clocks it borrows from, and suits concrete, steel or black-and-white rooms.

item.title: Double Face Clock, Rectangle · Green
item.description: The kind of two-sided clock you'd check on a station platform, reworked for home. DULTON drew it as a long, low rectangle so it sits comfortably under HK ceiling heights, with embossed resin details and a glass cover. In green it feels more vintage and playful, and looks good against wood, rattan or cream walls.

item.title: Solid wood picture frame for Nara prints · White
item.description: White solid wood picture frame for the Nara prints, for hanging. Brand new. Face 20 mm and depth 20 mm. Outer size W 33.7 × D 2 × H 46 cm. The inner opening is sized for the Nara prints. An add-on for Green Eyes and Eye Patch, in stock in Hong Kong.

item.title: Rental-friendly wall hook, made in Japan, for DULTON clocks & pictures
item.description: Set of 2, silver / white, brand new. Made in Japan. A rental-friendly wall hook for gypsum board, for a DULTON clock, a picture, a Heller Swell (including Mini), or a Nara print in the solid wood picture frame. Holds up to 7 kg each.

item.title: Ice Cube Tray XXL · Ice Blue
item.description: HAY's Ice Cube Tray XXL holds six extra-large cubes in a compact silicone tray. This one is Ice blue, from the 2025 spring/summer collection (2025SS). Ours is HK$138. Official retail on HAY.nl is €25, about HK$228. Buy it with the Peach Square XL and the two trays together are HK$268.

item.title: Ice Cube Tray Square XL · Peach
item.description: HAY's Ice Cube Tray Square XL, in Peach, brand new with the tag. Twelve extra-large square compartments in a flexible silicone tray. Ours is HK$148. Official retail on HAY.nl is €25, about HK$228. Buy it with the Ice blue XXL and the two trays together are HK$268.

item.title: Rice Paper Shade Ø50
item.description: A round white rice-paper pendant, Ø50. Shade only. Brand new. Other sizes are available for pre-order.

item.title: Common Pendant Cord Set · Beton Grey
item.description: Ceiling cup, fabric cord and lamp holder in Beton Grey. Brand new. More colourways are available for pre-order.

item.title: HAY Manolito Stool · Natural Short
item.description: HAY Manolito stool in Natural Short. Brand new.

item.title: Green Eyes Print
item.description: Nara's child looks straight at you: two green eyes, a pair of plasters, a red collar on a blue sky. This print of Green Eyes (2002) is 28 × 36 cm. Brand new, unframed — lean it on a shelf, or add the white solid wood picture frame.

item.title: Eye Patch Print
item.description: The kid with the eye patch: one amber eye, a plaster cross, a yellow shirt on pink. This print of Untitled (Eye Patch) (2012) is 28 × 36 cm. Brand new, unframed — lean it on a shelf, or add the white solid wood picture frame.

item.title: AKARI 55D Pendant
item.description: Noguchi called his AKARI light sculptures rather than lamps, and the 55D shows why. Its bamboo ribbing is set in a loose, organic rhythm under hand-laid washi, so the light comes through soft and a little uneven, like paper held up to the sun. At 55 cm across it's generous enough to anchor a dining table or warm up a bare corner.

item.title: AKARI 30A Pendant
item.description: A smaller AKARI for bedrooms, reading corners and hallways. Like every piece in the series, it's washi paper over bamboo ribbing, made by hand in Gifu, where Noguchi first saw the town's lantern makers at work in 1951. Soft, diffused, quietly sculptural.

item.title: Swell Wall Catchall · White
item.description: Anna Dawson, a California surfer, shaped Swell after the rhythm of ocean waves. The crests catch coats, bags and caps; the troughs cradle keys and sunglasses. It's the entryway fix for a small flat that also happens to look like a sculpture. In white it almost disappears into a pale wall, leaving just the curves and their shadows: the most minimal of the three.

item.title: Swell Mini · Red Orange
item.description: One wave instead of three. Swell Mini is part hook, part catchall bowl: hang a tote, drop your glasses by the bed, or line a few up in different colours for a little wall composition. Small enough for any flat, and a very easy gift. Red Orange is the boldest of the three Swell Mini colours we have: a bright pop by the front door or on a pale wall.

item.title: Swell Mini · Cream
item.description: One wave instead of three. Swell Mini is part hook, part catchall bowl: hang a tote, drop your glasses by the bed, or line a few up in different colours for a little wall composition. Small enough for any flat, and a very easy gift. Cream is the quietest of the three: it sits softly against white and off-white walls, so the wave shape does the talking.

item.title: Swell Mini · Blue
item.description: One wave instead of three. Small enough for any flat, and a very easy gift. Blue brings a cool, calm note, and pairs nicely with the blue Swell if you'd like a matching big-and-small set.
